blocks.text: Experience Awesome with the Samsung Galaxy A16 5G - Discover a smartphone that combines all the essential features you love into one affordable and stylish device. The Samsung Galaxy A16 5G delivers a premium experience without the premium price tag, perfect for capturing, sharing, and streaming your world. A Display That Dazzles - Immerse yourself in a cinematic viewing experience on the stunning 6.5-inch FHD+ Super AMOLED Infinity-V Display. Colors are rich and vibrant, while the 90Hz refresh rate provides buttery-smooth scrolling and a seamless experience, whether you're browsing your favorite sites or competing in the latest mobile games. A Camera for Every Moment - Unleash your inner photographer with the powerful 50MP triple-camera system. Capture crisp, detailed photos in any light with the main camera, fit more into your frame with the ultrawide lens, and discover tiny details with the macro camera. The Galaxy A16 5G makes it easy to take share-worthy photos and videos. Battery and Storage to Keep Up With You, Live life without looking for an outlet. The long-lasting 5000mAh battery provides the power you need to stay connected, productive, and entertained all day long. When you do need a boost, Super Fast Charging gets you powered up in a flash. With 128GB of internal storage, expandable to a full terabyte, you have all the room you need for your photos, videos, apps, and memories. This device is locked to Tracfone, ensuring you get the full benefit of their reliable, award-winning 5G network. Activation is simple and requires a Tracfone calling plan. Get connected in minutes.

items.label: Carrier
items.value: This phone is locked to Tracfone, which means this device can only be used on the Tracfone Wireless network. A Tracfone plan is required to activate this device. Activating is easy, upon receipt go to the Tracfone Website and select “Activate” and follow the prompts.

items: VIBRANT DISPLAY, SMOOTH SCROLLING – Your content looks incredible on the edge-to-edge 6.5” FHD+ Super AMOLED display. Experience silky-smooth scrolling, gaming, and video with a 90Hz refresh rate that makes every interaction fluid and responsive.

CAPTURE LIFE IN HIGH-DEF – Snap stunning, high-resolution photos with the versatile 50MP triple-lens camera system. From breathtaking landscapes using the ultrawide lens to intricate details with the macro lens, you have the right tool for every shot.

POWER FOR YOUR DAY & SPACE FOR YOUR MEMORIES – The massive 5000mAh battery keeps you going all day on a single charge, and 25W Super Fast Charging gets you back in the action quickly. With 128GB of built-in storage, expandable up to 1TB with a microSD card (sold separately), you'll never have to worry about running out of space.

5G SPEED ON A RELIABLE NETWORK – Stream movies, download files, and game at incredible speeds with 5G connectivity. Powered by an efficient octa-core processor, the Galaxy A16 is built to perform on Verizon's powerful and dependable nationwide network.
